review_method: AI-assisted visual inspection of every locally rendered PNG page; not independent human engineering validation.
scope: Published English technical report only. Native full-run report QA is recorded separately in its ignored run directory.

pages.comments: Cover, real CAD render, integration scope and limitation table are readable.
Input-change results and three real CAD geometries fit; model estimates are explicitly labeled.
Coefficient equations and performance curves are legible; numerical convergence is separated from physical validation.
CAD quantities and two mesh checks are readable; geometry/BEM mismatch is disclosed.
Benchmark, preliminary elasticity and missing safety allowables are clearly distinguished.
Motor-capacity failures are retained; dynamics plots and startup surrogate limits are legible.
Thirteen design rows fit; ranking excludes uncalculated elasticity and is not presented as a global optimum.
Fresh release-native execution is distinguished from saved examples; dependency, rights and human-review boundaries are clear.
